ns2:course.label: Diseases Hemato & Lymph Tissue
ns2:course.description: Course covers the benign reactive and neoplastic diseases of the bone marrow and lymphoid systems. A comparative approach will be taken with diseases considered from both human and animal aspects utilizing current information on causation, genetic, phenotypic, and morphologic characteristics. Preference for enrollment will be given to candidates with DVM degrees or medical scholars. Prerequisite: Graduate student standing or consent of instructor.
